analysis_type: exploratory withheld top-surface patches on one source tooth
plan_status: written before this patch experiment's evaluation; not independently preregistered
privileged_extent_information: full source XY bounding extent and metric scale supplied; no camera/scale recovery
holdout_rule: remove every OES triangle whose XY projection intersects the patch disk; rasterize support only from retained faces
query_rule: all regular-grid points inside the disk; no outcome-dependent selection
support_rule: regular-grid annulus from radius+0.15 to radius+1.0; finite retained-surface top-envelope observations
internal_imaging_branch: full source EDJ available in its shared pose; fit OES-minus-EDJ vertical gaps on visible support
prediction_rule: save all coefficients and prediction hashes before computing the full-reference target heights
primary_outputs: separate excess and deficit envelope-volume proxies
scoring_gate: score only when every query has a full-reference hit and a finite prediction; preserve incomplete cases as unscored rows
scope: 2.5D top-envelope geometry only; not full 3D fracture repair, photos, enamel identity, tissue growth or human treatment
